name: Planar Caller
body:
When you cast one of the planar ally or planar binding spells, more powerful creatures come to your aid.

Prerequisite: Knowledge (planar) 7 ranks

Benefit: When you cast any of the planar ally or planar binding spells, you can call an outsider with 1 HD more than the spell would normally allow.

Book of Magic: 7 Spellcaster Feats. ©2013 Jon Brazer Enterprises
